lines.quote: Developing and maintaining embedded signal processing firmware in C++ for Hallaharju’s industrial monitoring product line, including real-time data acquisition on ARM Cortex-M7 microcontrollers and custom DSP pipeline implementations

Designed and deployed a production Python system for automated fault detection and diagnostic reporting across Hallaharju’s deployed monitoring stations, running on-site Linux servers with systemd service management and PostgreSQL data storage; the system processes continuous sensor data streams and generates daily health reports for field operations
